correctness.rationale: Unitary conjugation gives the explicit weighted geometric triangular kernel. A finite-rank and trace-class reduction yields half of a diagonal 1/k multiplier times an absolutely summable 2×2 Toeplitz operator. The supplied cutoff/band-limited block-counting proof establishes tN(t) as an integral of symbol nuclear norm; this is an infinite statement, not an extrapolated finite computation. The determinant/Frobenius calculation gives the exact displayed constant. A column orthogonality test gives the only possible Bloch crossing, and strict positivity of the parameter derivative proves contrast rigidity. Exact rational finite inverses, 2×2 checks and finite-section eigenvalue tests executed, with limits explicitly separated from finite tests.

value.rationale: On a natural nonhomogeneous weighted Hilbert space, all eigenvalues remain 1/j, so they cannot detect the periodic weight contrast. The exact singular Weyl coefficient strictly detects its magnitude, yielding a nontrivial inverse spectral diagnostic and a Bloch-branch crossing criterion; it simultaneously quantifies critical Schatten membership. The contrast-dependent integral is a natural sharp invariant of the full infinite operator, not an arbitrary finite slice or numerical table.
